errors.evidence: The description states that each year is represented by two stacked columns, but the chart shows a single stacked column for each year, which is composed of two segments.
The description incorrectly identifies 2021 as the year with the lowest yield. Visually, the bar for 2020 is the shortest, indicating the lowest yield in that year.

This value is stated in reference to the year 2021, but the bar for 2021 is significantly higher, at approximately 178,000 tonnes. The value of ~160,000 tonnes corresponds to the lowest year, 2020, not 2021.
